Analyze an uploaded advertisement image and return the top 3-5 most impactful design change suggestions to improve ROI and CTA.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
></Heading>

<ParamsDetails parameters={undefined}></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{
    required: true,
    content: {
      "multipart/form-data": {
        schema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            file: {
              type: "string",
              format: "binary",
              description: "Image file to analyze (JPEG, PNG, WebP, max 35MB)",
            },
            tenant_information: {
              type: "string",
              description:
                "Property type or industry context (e.g., real estate, commercial, residential). Defaults to general property.",
            },
          },
          required: ["file"],
        },
        examples: {
          basic: {
            summary: "Recommend variations for an ad image",
            value: { file: "ad_popup.jpg", tenant_information: "real estate" },
          },
          commercial: {
            summary: "Commercial property ad",
            value: {
              file: "commercial_ad.jpg",
              tenant_information: "commercial property",
            },
          },
          residential: {
            summary: "Residential property ad",
            value: {
              file: "residential_ad.jpg",
              tenant_information: "residential property",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  }}
></RequestSchema>
